rules: V2-00 through V2-05 may not read DFCI or VICC predictor or outcome rows.
Do not regenerate or inspect frozen DFCI/VICC predictions.
Do not read quarantined BPC hard-outcome source files, including the MSK regimen-level outcome table.
BPC-MSK derived scan-schema positive-control artifacts are permitted.
CHORD and GENIE development artifacts are permitted.
Historical external summary JSON may be cited manually from the handoff but is not an input to V2 model selection.
